units: pixels (x right, y down, origin top-left of the 2560x1440 frame) and seconds; t = frame/24

camera.motion: static (no pan/shake; background pixels identical between frames apart from the moving drone and lid)
camera.notes: 2D scene, viewed side-on; drone rises vertically in the image plane. No metric scale known.

objects.name: drone
objects.description: small black cylindrical drone (dark cylinder body with a light-grey round top plate and 4 arms with spinning rotors/blurred blades at the top). Starts nested in the top of the robot, rises straight up.
objects.reference_point: ref_x,ref_y = centre of the drone's full image bbox (x = cylinder axis 1330.5; y = midpoint of top_y and bottom_y). For frames 0-25 the cylinder bottom is hidden inside the robot, bottom_y = top_y + 194 (rigid height).

size_px.blade_tip_span_with_blur: 231-280 (varies frame to frame because the rotors spin)
size_px.top_plate_band_height: about 20 (top bar y=top..top+6, plate, arms to about top+28)

objects.motion_summary_px: top edge y: 940 (f0), 940 (f1), 933 (f2) ... 457 (f71); moves straight up at a steady rate from frame 1-2 to the end, x constant at 1330.5. Net rise 483 px over frames 1-71.

objects.name: robot
objects.description: black boxy wheeled delivery-type robot (the drone's carrier), centre-bottom of the image; chamfered top-left corner, white base with wheels at bottom; hatch lid on its top-left.

size_px.note: wheel bottoms partly hidden by ground ridge in front (y > ~1390); white wheels left about x 1035-1160, right about x 1380-1500

objects.name: lid
objects.description: hatch lid / flap on top of the robot, a tan panel with a dark curved handle, hinged near (1197, 992) at the robot's top-left. Open, tilted up-left, at the start; swings over to the right (closing) during the clip.
objects.angle_deg_convention: angle of hinge->tip from image +x, counter-clockwise with y up (90 = vertical)

objects.name: background
objects.description: pink/red sandstone cliff with rock ledges, dry grass at top, reddish shallow water/mud and grey rocky ground at the bottom; static.

events.note: top y 940 at frames 0 and 1, 933 at frame 2; already moving at full steady rate between frames 1 and 2
tip static frames 0-21, first change at frame 22

events.event: drone cylinder bottom clears the robot top
clip ends with drone still rising and lid still closing
